post.description: Single-use authorization code with PKCE, registered Admin principal and verified MFA; sets only the HttpOnly cp_admin_session cookie. Ordinary user authentication cannot produce an Admin session.

UserBearer.description: Product user token scoped by server-side membership.

DeviceBearer.description: Device-only token; not interchangeable with user credentials.

AdminSession.name: cp_admin_session
AdminSession.description: Independent Admin-only audience, MFA and server-side authorization version. Never accepts cp_session or user/device bearer tokens.

TenantHeader.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantHeader.description: Selected tenant; server must validate membership and resource ownership.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfHeader.description: Required for cookie-authenticated mutations; bearer clients use token/origin policy.

AdminCsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
AdminCsrfHeader.description: Admin-context csrf_admin plus strict Origin verification; normal user CSRF tokens are invalid.

ErrorResponse.description: Structured error; status-specific semantics are documented in API guide.

amount_micros.description: One millionth of currency; decimal integer string.

parameters.description: Validated against the selected versioned capability parameter schema; never forwarded as arbitrary tool execution.

runtime_profile_id.description: Must resolve to an enabled, version-pinned Codex runtime profile. Kernel overrides and automatic kernel fallback are prohibited.
